findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.trulyrandomverse.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_book_overview, get_church_fathers, search_fathers, compare_versions, get_site_help · Private data: get_strongs_for_verse, get_word_origin, search_fathers · Public sink: get_book_overview, get_cross_references, get_site_help.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_book_overview, get_church_fathers, search_fathers, compare_versions, get_site_help · Private data: get_strongs_for_verse, get_word_origin, search_fathers · Public sink: get_book_overview, get_cross_references, get_site_help

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
